verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents API keys, but only as personal access tokens that call the same endpoints the web UI uses. Nothing in the evidence shows scopes, per-key permissions, or least-privilege credentials for an agent. RBAC governs user roles and permissions, which is an adjacent control rather than scoped credential issuance, so the story is not delivered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
